$comment: ADR-0013/0021 budgets, measured per ADR-0022 (software GL in CI) and ADR-0030 (CPU budgets on shared runners: ciStat/ciMax apply when CI is set). stat is mean, median or p95; report-only metrics have no threshold.

storage.append10k.$comment: ADR-0021 budget; on shared CI runners gated on the median at 2x (ADR-0030)

sim.stateLatency.$comment: with rendering; not gated on software GL (ADR-0022)

render.frameWork.reference.$comment: F1 acceptance (frame time while agents move and a path is planned): 1 km² reference world, scout flying, rover planning cross-map over the whole window; initial atlas upload excluded (render.frameWork.referenceUpload). Budget 4 ms (ADR-0013) on p95 locally; CI gates the median at 2x (ADR-0030). Measured at gating: local p95 0.3 ms (Ryzen 7 9800X3D, SwiftShader); CI run 37836508879 (ca1dca3, report-only) median 0.40 ms, p95 0.70 ms; first gated CI run 37844516454 (1a26fb6) median 0.40 ms, p95 0.80 ms (AMD EPYC 7763, 2 threads, SwiftShader); hardware GPU (RTX 3080, bench:gpu 2026-10-08) p95 0.30 ms.

render.frameWork.referenceUpload.$comment: F1 f3: frame work while the 1,024 atlas chunks upload (≤ 16 per frame, ADR-0027); outside the gated window

render.frameWork.referenceOverlays.$comment: F2 M2e5 (proposed for approval): frame time on the 1 km² reference world with the belief overlay on in its heaviest form (researcher-only difference mode: two textures) over the airborne scout's growing map while the scout and the rover move; the belief upload is outside the window (render.frameWork.beliefUpload). Same method as render.frameWork.reference: 4 ms (ADR-0013) on p95 locally, CI gates the median at 2x (ADR-0030). With the scout's lidar rays and its regions and frontier groups drawn as well (M2e6), measured locally (3 runs, SwiftShader): p95 0.3 ms, median 0.2 ms, mean 0.16-0.18 ms (belief and difference only, M2e5: p95 0.3-0.4 ms); first CI run with the gate (run 38162797928, AMD EPYC, 2 threads, SwiftShader): median 0.50 ms, p95 1.10 ms, mean 0.62 ms against the 8 ms median gate.

render.frameWork.beliefUpload.$comment: F2 M2e5: frame work while a whole known 1 km² belief map uploads (1,024 chunks within the shared <= 16 per frame, ADR-0027); measured p95 0.6 ms, mean 0.37-0.39 ms

render.beliefShowMs.$comment: F2 M2e5: wall time from switching the belief overlay on to the whole known 1 km² map drawn (worker, transfer and 63 upload frames); measured 1.92-1.95 s locally (software GL)

load.workspaceVisible.$comment: first workspace visible; dockview is loaded after first paint (issue #4)

bundle.fonts.gzip.$comment: all self-hosted font files (ADR-0032 §4); only the preloaded face counts in bundle.initial.gzip

bundle.lazy.editor.gzip.$comment: scenario editor panel chunk (F1 e7); three.js is counted under bundle.lazy.scene (vendor-three, shared)

bundle.lazy.runController.gzip.$comment: run starting and presets on the main thread (F1 f1); the presets themselves are built in the sim worker

bundle.lazy.inspector.gzip.$comment: Inspector panel, agent views and the stream hook (F2 M2e): what the mind receives, researcher view, commands

bundle.lazy.commands.gzip.$comment: the palette's researcher commands and demo presets, loaded when the palette first opens (F2 M2e1)

bundle.lazy.runInfo.gzip.$comment: run header popover, loaded on first open

bundle.lazy.recording.gzip.$comment: recording status in the status line (loaded when a run exists) and the recording choice store (F3a M2); the choice controls ride in the run popover chunk

bundle.lazy.timeline.gzip.$comment: the Debug workspace's Timeline panel with its marks and jump hooks (F3a M3)

bundle.lazy.eventList.gzip.$comment: the Debug workspace's event list panel (F3a M3)

bundle.lazy.replay.gzip.$comment: the replay session: its host, the replay bar and the replay run source (F3a M3); the replay module of the storage worker is its own chunk of that worker

bundle.lazy.sharedMui.gzip.$comment: MUI controls shared by the lazy panels (TextField, ToggleButtonGroup, Popover, FormControlLabel)

bundle.lazy.sharedContracts.gzip.$comment: contract validation and scenario code shared by the lazy panels (editor, run configuration)

bundle.worker.sim.gzip.$comment: sim worker bundle (core, spatial, algorithms, scenarios); not part of first paint

bundle.worker.storage.gzip.$comment: storage worker bundle (SQLite WASM glue); not part of first paint

bundle.initial.gzip.$comment: ADR-0032 §3 gate, set at F1 close: 175716 B measured + 2%. F2 close measured 176924 B (172.8 KB), within it; the re-baseline to 180462 B proposed at F2 phase close was not approved and is reverted (2026-10-12). Contract schemas are guarded out of the initial chunk by the bundle report (ADR-0018 addition of 2026-10-12).

spatial.pyramidBuild.$comment: 1 km² at 0.5 m reference world (F1 milestone b); thresholds once planning budgets land

scenario.layersRleBytes.$comment: ADR-0025: encoded layer size of the reference world

scenario.referenceDocumentBytes.$comment: ADR-0025: full reference scenario document (pretty JSON, as exported)

planning.hpaCrossMapQuery.$comment: ADR-0024 / F1 plan: cross-map HPA* query, graph built. ADR-0030: real budget locally on p95; CI gates the median at 2x

planning.hpaCrossMapExpansions.$comment: hardware-independent count: same gate locally and in CI (ADR-0030)

planning.slice20k.$comment: one 20k-expansion A* step per agent (F1 plan). ADR-0030: real budget locally on p95; CI gates the median at 2x

sim.sensing20x180.$comment: F2 M2a: sensing phase per tick, 20 UGVs with the built-in sensors (180-ray lidar 30 m at 10 Hz) on the 1 km² reference world. Measured after the optimization pass (Ryzen 7 9800X3D): median 6.0 ms, p95 7.0 ms. ADR-0030: local p95 with ~30 % margin, CI median at 2x

sim.tick20AgentsSensing.$comment: F2 acceptance tick budget (2026-10-09): a whole tick for 20 agents with the built-in sensors at 10 Hz, no planning query in flight (planning stays bounded per agent by planning.slice20k), <= 25 ms p95 locally (a quarter of the 100 ms period). Measured: median 6.2 ms, p95 8.2 ms

sim.tick20AgentsExploring.$comment: F2 tick budget for exploring agents (2026-10-10): the same whole tick for 20 agents that reveal new cells every tick (moved 1 m between ticks), planning views prepared: sensing, view sync, topology, runtime, state hash; no planning query in flight. <= 25 ms p95 locally. Measured after the per-cell view sync pass: median 14.1 ms, p95 17.6 ms

observer.beliefVsTruth20Exploring.$comment: ADR-0035 target for metrics, ADR-0005 addition (M2d4; 2026-10-11): the observer's own work per tick (sampling plus recount, timed directly, zero on ticks when no agent is due) for 20 exploring agents; <= 0.5 ms p95 locally, CI median at 2x. Measured: mean 0.017 ms, p95 0.020 ms, max 1.7 ms (first samples, 77 of 380 ticks do any work).

recording.addedPerTick.$comment: ADR-0013 addition of 2026-10-18, the recorder budget: what recording adds to a tick at the 20-agent reference (the recording's hook plus its share of the poll that hands batches over, default profile), <= 1 ms p95 locally, CI median at 2x. Measured (F3a close): mean 0.22 ms, median 0.20 ms, p95 0.33 ms

render.scrub10min.$comment: F3a M3, acceptance 3: frame work while the cursor is dragged over a 10-minute recording with the belief overlay on (budget p95 <= 4 ms locally); produced by AGENTSIM_BENCH_SCRUB=1. Measured: p95 0.50 ms

render.scrub10min.firstOverlay.$comment: F3a M3: from a moved cursor to the first updated belief overlay on a 10-minute recording (budget <= 200 ms); produced by AGENTSIM_BENCH_SCRUB=1. Measured: median 37 ms, p95 54 ms

render.scrub1km.$comment: F3a M3: the same frame work on a recording of the 1 km2 world; produced by AGENTSIM_BENCH_SCRUB=1. Measured: p95 0.70 ms

render.scrub1km.firstOverlay.$comment: F3a M3: the same first overlay on the 1 km2 world; produced by AGENTSIM_BENCH_SCRUB=1. Measured: median 20 ms, p95 26 ms

planning.viewSync20Exploring.$comment: Live planning views (ADR-0024 addition of 2026-10-10): the after-sensing sync point for 20 exploring agents. 14.2 ms p95 with chunk rebuilds; 1.3 ms p95 with per-cell refresh from the belief map's change log

topology.update20Agents.$comment: ADR-0039 section 4: per-tick topology maintenance for 20 agents moving 1 m per tick; report first, then a gate

topology.firstUpdate20Agents.$comment: The first topology build for 20 agents (at assembly, load time)

sim.requestBuild20Agents.$comment: ADR-0005 addition of 2026-10-11: building the beliefs, space and menu of a request for 20 agents on explored 1 km2 maps, views warm (per-region waypoint memo; the first request after a region changes also rescans that region, about 1 ms). 57.8 ms before the memo

trace.requestBytesPerAgentHour.$comment: ADR-0005 addition of 2026-10-11 (M2d): bytes of request records (op request and op space, payload JSON) per agent per hour of sim time, 20 UGVs exploring the 1 km2 reference world; space summaries deduplicated by 64-bit hash, allowed actions as names plus the manifest hash

trace.requestBytesPerAgentHour.inlined.$comment: The same requests with every space summary and every parameter schema inlined: what the deduplication saves

trace.requestsPerAgentHour.$comment: Decision requests per agent per hour of sim time in the same run (perception events at minDecisionIntervalS 1 s, and control events)

sim.beliefHash20Explored.$comment: Belief maps in the per-tick state hash (cached per chunk): 20 fully explored 1 km2 maps, 9 chunks changed per agent per tick

load.planningPrepare.$comment: F2 M1a: planning view + HPA* graph built before tick 0 on the 1 km² reference world (one UGV, ADR-0024 'at scenario load'); load time, never tick time

planning.serviceTick20Plain.$comment: F2b M2 (ADR-0037): one PlanningService tick of 20 agents, each stepping one 20k-expansion slice of a cross-map A* query on the 1 km² world (plain algorithm). The A/B reference for the strategy rows below. Local median about 88 ms (the same work as planning.perTick20Agents, through the service)

planning.serviceTick20OneNodeStrategy.$comment: F2b M2: the same tick with the same A* as a one-node strategy: the stage runner's overhead. Measured against the plain row, interleaved over several runs: no difference beyond noise (87.8 vs 88.9 ms mean median)

planning.strategySlice20AstarThenHpa.$comment: F2b M2: the shipped astar-then-hpa strategy, 20 agents, one tick: A* is cut at its 5,000-expansion stage budget (about 1 ms per agent) and HPA* then plans the whole query inside the same 20k slice (about 12k expansions); local median about 177 ms for the 20 agents

planning.strategySlice20ShortLong.$comment: F2b M2: the shipped short-astar-long-hpa strategy, 20 agents, one tick: cross-map queries take the HPA* branch (local median about 158 ms for 20 queries, 7.9 ms each)

sim.tickNoPlanning.$comment: F1 acceptance (tick budget split): world tick with one agent moving, planning phase idle. ADR-0030: real budget locally on p95; CI gates the median at 2x
